responsibility: Implements the call-specific branch of GCC’s tree constant folder for built-in and internal functions represented by combined_fn. It recognizes constant arguments to math, string, memory, and selected internal helper calls; evaluates floating builtins through MPFR when the target format can be modeled exactly; canonicalizes comparison-like results; and returns folded tree constants or pointer expressions for functions such as strcmp/memchr/fma/sincos-style operations, separating function-call evaluation from the more general expression folding in fold-const.c.
same_name_distinction: Implements the call-folding half of the fold-const interface: it folds combined_fn builtins and internal calls, including MPFR-backed math and string/memory call evaluation, whereas gcc/fold-const-call.h only declares those entry points and gcc/fold-const.c handles broader non-call expression folding.
